gloss: as usual; as before; same as always

definitions.gloss: as usual; as before; same as always
definitions.explanation: Expresses that something should stay or will stay the same as it has been up to now, emphasizing continuity and the absence of change. Very natural in both spoken and written Japanese.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}まで{通|どお}りでいい。
examples.english: The same as before is fine.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}まで{通|どお}りの{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to live the same life as before.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}が{変|か}わっても、{今|いま}まで{通|どお}りのやり{方|かた}で{仕事|しごと}を{進|すす}めてください。
examples.english: Even though the department head has changed, please continue working the same way as before.

notes:
A very common expression combining {今|いま}まで (until now) and {通|どお}り (as, in the manner of). Used to express continuity — that something should stay or will stay the same as it has been. Natural in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今|いま}まで{通|どお}り + verb: to do something as usual
- {今|いま}まで{通|どお}りの + noun: the same ~ as usual
- {今|いま}まで{通|どお}りに{暮|く}らす: to live as one always has

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り — as before (slightly more formal; emphasizes a past reference point)
- {従来|じゅうらい}{通|どお}り — as has been conventionally done (formal/institutional)
- いつも{通|どお}り — as always (focuses on habitual pattern)
